Name: DialogToClipboard
Author: dlrdlrdlr
Description:
[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]just install the mod normally, and it'll automatically work
[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

I've only personally tested on Linux in single-player but see no reason it should conflict.



[url=https://github.com/dlrdlrdlr/DialogToClipboard]Source[/url]

Manifest.Name: DialogToClipboard
Manifest.Description: This mod automatically places any dialog into the system clipboard
